name: AnimationBehavior
coverage: Read Flutter AnimationBehavior (normal and preserve) against controller.rs:73 and set_disable_animations (controller.rs:90-96). Preserve-mode duration handling is not frame-tested; the existing Rust test crates/incular-animation/tests/animation_behavior.rs covers disabled-motion scaling only.

name: AnimationController
coverage: Frame-checked: forward, reverse, animateTo (curved, target below value), animateBack, finite repeat(reverse, count), fling (positive and negative), animateWith, stop, reset, value setter mid-run and out-of-range clamp, bounds 0.2-0.8. Unchecked: repeat without reverse and with min/max other than 0.2-0.8, toggle, drive/driveRange, unbounded(), dispose, AnimationBehavior.preserve. Value/status listener counts diverge (anim_core-001, anim_core-002).

name: Animation
coverage: Read Flutter Animation<T> (value, status, listener protocol, isAnimating, isForwardOrCompleted) against value.rs:63 and animations.rs:16-31. Controller value and status are scenario-checked; derived animations do not expose the listener protocol (anim_core-004). Non-double value types unchecked.

name: AnimationStatus
coverage: All four statuses sampled as codes in controller scenarios. Helpers isAnimating and isForwardOrCompleted read against controller.rs:47 and :65; both definitions match Flutter animation.dart:42-57.

name: AnimationEagerListenerMixin
coverage: rg -n for AnimationEagerListenerMixin, EagerListener and listener mixin names in crates (non-test) found no counterpart. Derived Incular animations have no listener protocol (anim_core-004).

name: AnimationLazyListenerMixin
coverage: rg -n for AnimationLazyListenerMixin and LazyListener in crates (non-test) found no counterpart. Derived Incular animations have no listener protocol (anim_core-004).

name: AnimationLocalListenersMixin
coverage: Controller add_listener/remove_listener (controller.rs:940-955) checked for value-notification counts; count divergence is anim_core-001. Removal during dispatch and listeners on derived animations are unchecked.

name: AnimationLocalStatusListenersMixin
coverage: Controller add_status_listener/remove_status_listener (controller.rs:957-965) checked for status-notification counts; the first-run forward divergence is anim_core-002. Removal during dispatch and derived-animation status listeners are unchecked.

name: defaultSchedulingStrategy
coverage: Out of scope: priority-based policy for SchedulerBinding.scheduleTask async work. rg for schedulingStrategy, scheduleTask and Priority found no counterpart; the policy does not drive frames, tickers or frame callbacks, and the frame harness has no probe for it.

name: PerformanceModeRequestHandle
coverage: Out of scope: embedder performance-mode request handle (requestPerformanceMode); platform/engine plumbing with no widget-observable frame behavior in the harness.

name: SchedulerBinding
coverage: Frame entry points begin_frame (scheduler.rs:123) and end_frame (:152) are exercised; one-shot begin-frame callbacks, cancellation and post-frame callbacks match. Unchecked: persistent frame callbacks (neither API can unregister them; see harness request), transient-before-post-frame ordering within one frame, schedulerPhase, and the time-dilation API (anim_core-003).

name: SchedulerPhase
coverage: rg -n for SchedulerPhase, schedulerPhase and phase in crates/incular-animation/src found no counterpart. Phase is observable only to code that reads it during a frame; no frame-harness probe exists, so no finding is recorded (see open questions).

name: debugAssertAllSchedulerVarsUnset
coverage: Out of scope: debug-only assertion helper for scheduler globals in Flutter debug builds; no runtime or widget-observable behavior.

name: debugPrintBeginFrameBanner
coverage: Out of scope: debug console banner (debugPrintBeginFrameBanner) with no observable widget behavior.

name: debugPrintEndFrameBanner
coverage: Out of scope: debug console banner (debugPrintEndFrameBanner) with no observable widget behavior.

name: debugPrintScheduleFrameStacks
coverage: Out of scope: debug stack printing toggle for scheduleFrame calls; debug tooling only.

name: debugTracePostFrameCallbacks
coverage: Out of scope: debug tracing flag for post-frame callbacks; debug tooling only.

name: Priority
coverage: Out of scope: task priority levels used only by SchedulerBinding.scheduleTask (see defaultSchedulingStrategy); rg for Priority in incular-animation and incular-runtime found no counterpart and no frame or ticker path depends on it.

name: SchedulerServiceExtensions
coverage: Out of scope: DevTools service-extension registration for scheduler state; diagnostics tooling with no widget-observable behavior.

name: Ticker
coverage: Start, stop and muting are frame-checked by anim_core__ticker_mute_resume: a muted ticker stops calling back, and after unmuting the elapsed time still counts from start (match). Scheduler-wide time dilation is missing (anim_core-003). Ticker cancel() and absorb_ticker are unchecked.

name: TickerCanceled
coverage: Cancellation outcome (-1) observed through is_canceled in scenarios that stop or reassign mid-run (match). TickerOrCancel error path (scheduler.rs:444-503) read against Flutter TickerFuture.orCancel.

name: TickerFuture
coverage: Completion (1) and cancellation (-1) outcomes match for forward, animateTo, animateBack, finite repeat, animateWith, fling (both directions) and set_value/stop cancellation.

name: TickerProvider
coverage: rg -n for TickerProvider, createTicker and TickerProviderStateMixin in crates (non-test) found no trait. Controllers create tickers through with_vsync (controller.rs:494); see anim_core-005.

name: TickerMode
coverage: Read TickerMode scope (environment.rs:469) and the retained-tree mute check (tree/interaction.rs:2159 and animation_muted at :2187). Retained-tree tickers are muted; a standalone with_vsync controller is not (anim_core-005). No frame twin, because the Flutter ticker-provider-driven mute cannot be reproduced without a widget-aware controller.

name: timeDilation
coverage: Getter/setter (binding.dart:37,45) read. Diagnostic trace only (non-equivalent settings): Flutter timeDilation=2 gives 8,000 us where Incular retained-animation scale 0.5 gives raw 16,000 us. Scheduler-wide dilation is missing (anim_core-003).
